step_zero.title: Welcome to your workspace
step_zero.description: To help you get started, we’ve created a Demo Project for you. Let’s add your first work item.

step_one.title: Click “+ Add work item”
step_one.description: Start by clicking the “+ New Work Item” button. You can create tasks, bugs, or custom type that fits your needs.

step_two.title: Filter your work items
step_two.description: Use filters to quickly narrow down your list. You can filter by status, priority, or team members.

step_three.title: View, group, and order work items as needed.
step_three.description: See required properties, and group or order work items as per your needs.

step_four.title: Visualize however you want
step_four.description: Select which properties you want to see in the list. You can also group and sort work items your way.

step_zero.title: Make progress with Cycles
step_zero.description: Press Q to create a Cycle. Name it and set dates—only one cycle per project.

step_one.title: Create a new cycle
step_one.description: Press Q to create a Cycle. Name it and set dates—only one cycle per project.

step_two.title: Click “+ ”
step_two.description: Start by clicking the “+” button. Add new or existing work items directly from the Cycle page.

step_three.title: Cycle summary
step_three.description: Track cycle progress, team productivity, and priorities—and investigate if things fall behind.

step_four.title: Transfer work items
step_four.description: After the due date, a cycle auto-completes. Move unfinished work to another cycle.

step_zero.title: Break your project down into Modules
step_zero.description: Modules are smaller, focused projects that help users group and organize work items within specific time frames.

step_one.title: Create Module
step_one.description: Modules are smaller, focused projects that help users group and organize work items within specific time frames.

step_two.title: Click “+ ”
step_two.description: Start by clicking the “+” button. Add new or existing work items directly from the Module page.

step_three.title: Module states
step_three.description: Modules use these statuses to help users plan and clearly track progress and stage.

step_four.title: Module progress
step_four.description: Module progress is tracked via completed items, with analytics to monitor performance.

step_zero.title: Document with AI-powered Pages
step_zero.description: Pages in Plane let you capture, organize, and collaborate on project info—no external tools needed.

step_one.title: Make page Public or Private
step_one.description: Pages can be set as public, visible to everyone in your workspace, or private, accessible only to you.

step_two.title: Use / command
step_two.description: Use / on a page to add content from 16 block types, including lists, images, tables, and embeds.

step_three.title: Page actions
step_three.description: Once your page is created, you can click the ••• menu in the top-right corner to perform the following actions.

step_four.title: Table of contents
step_four.description: Get a bird’s-eye view of your page by clicking the panel icon to see all headings.

step_five.title: Version history
step_five.description: Pages track all edits with version history, letting you restore previous versions if needed.

step_zero.title: Streamline requests with intake
step_zero.description: A Plane-only feature that lets Guests create work items for bugs, requests, or tickets.

step_one.title: Open/closed intake requests
step_one.description: Pending requests stay in the Open tab, and once addressed by an admin or member, they move to Closed.

step_two.title: Accept/decline a pending request
step_two.description: Accept to edit and move the work item to your project, or decline it to mark it as Cancelled.

step_three.title: Snooze for now
step_three.description: A work item can be snoozed to review it at a later time. It will be moved to the bottom of your open request list.

step_zero.title: Stop tab-switching. Connect your world.
step_zero.description: Link GitHub, Slack to track PRs and summarize chats directly in Plane AI.

modal.title: Navigation, re-imagined
modal.sub_title: Your workspace is now easier to explore with a smarter, simplified navigation.
modal.highlight_1: Streamlined left-panel structure for quicker discovery
modal.highlight_2: Improved global search to jump to anything instantly
modal.highlight_3: Smarter category grouping for clarity and focus

step_zero.title: Find anything instantly
step_zero.description: Use universal search to jump to tasks, projects, pages, and people—without leaving your flow.

step_one.title: Stay in control of updates
step_one.description: Your inbox keeps all mentions, approvals, and activity in one place, so you never miss important work.

step_two.title: Personalize Your Navigation
step_two.description: Customize what you see and how you navigate in Preferences.
